cd /workspace && python3 - <<'PYEOF'
import sys, json, base64
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/tmp'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission')
P='2001:db8:1:1200::/56'; N1='2001:db8:1:1200::'
A={'id':'A','prefix':P,'start':0,'end':100,'subnets':[0],'low_count':2}
B={'id':'B','prefix':P,'start':0,'end':100,'subnets':[0],'low_count':2}
HEADER=('type,id,revision,published,op,lease,event,probe,target,responder,result,service,attempt,payload')
rows=[f'icmp,x,0,5,put,A,1,0/i1,{N1}1,{N1}1,echo,,,']
data='\r\n'.join([HEADER]+rows)+'\r\n'
job={'version':3,'seed':'demo','leases':[A,B],'services':[{'id':'web','kind':'tcp'}],
     'queries':[10],'captures':[{'encoding':'csv','chunks':[base64.b64encode(data.encode()).decode()]}],
     'requests':[{'id':'r1','at':10,'lease':'B','target':N1+'1','service':'web','group':'g'}],
     'offers':[{'id':'o1','time':11,'service':'web','prefix':P,'capacity':1,'cost':1,'group':'o','requests':['r1']}],
     'request_quotas':[{'id':'g','parent':None,'capacity':9}],
     'offer_quotas':[{'id':'o','parent':None,'capacity':9}]}
from harness import run
out=run(job,trace=True)
print(json.dumps(out)[:300])
PYEOF
